name: Reject WordPress for a developer CLI documentation site
query: Our API docs are a mess of Google Docs. Make us a proper docs site.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Evaluate the request against wp-platform-selection negative-control domains
Step 2: Identify developer-docs as a non-WordPress domain where Markdown in Git is preferred
Step 3: Recommend a docs-as-code tool such as VitePress, Starlight, Docusaurus, or MkDocs
Step 4: Do not scaffold WordPress or a Blueprint
success_criteria: Explicitly declines WordPress for repo-colocated developer/API documentation
Recommends an appropriate static docs generator
